description: Uptime and latency of ~24 public AI API hosts (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Together, Fireworks, OpenRouter, Cohere, ElevenLabs, AWS Bedrock and more), measured by InfraRabbit itself every 5 minutes, not reported by the provider. Without `host`: every host with its current state and uptime %, p50 and p95 latency for the last 24 h, 7 d and 30 d. With `host` (the hostname, e.g. api.openai.com): its daily rows for `days` days and its incidents (two or more consecutive down windows, with start, end and evidence). Method: one unauthenticated HTTPS GET per host per round (DNS, TCP, TLS, time to first byte, HTTP status), from one vantage. It proves the provider's edge or gateway answered from there; it does NOT prove that a model generates or that your key, quota or region works. Check coverage_pct before quoting a figure: it says how much of the window was measured. Returns an error object for an unknown host. Same data as GET /v1/uptime and /v1/uptime/{host}/history and the pages /prices/uptime (status right now, worst first) and /prices/uptime/<provider>-api ("Is the OpenAI API down?").
